inference_provenance.scoring: Rec-BIR npm_db (1 s, +/-256 sample lag) and compute_variable_mspacing_acoustic_errors
inference_provenance.display_preprocessing: shared channel-0 direct-peak crop with 2.5 ms pre-roll, then per-trace peak normalization
inference_provenance.waveform_metric: normalized waveform MAE after the same display preprocessing
inference_provenance.npm_metric: raw 1 s RIRs passed to Rec-BIR npm_db; no time-shift crop is applied
inference_provenance.snr_protocol: fixed 10 dB, 20 dB, and 30 dB mixtures; 20 rows per SNR
